review.gallery: Nine original Belgrove-branded Ellington renders from the historical brochure, with the same tower on the listing card. Generic lifestyle and wildlife imagery excluded.
review.location: The historical original Belgrove map independently matches the E44 locality on the named listing. Eight estimates verified visually from page 6. Proposed Metro is qualified and excluded from the current travel cards.
review.floorPlans: Eighteen complete plans: eight residential, four retail, three typical plates and three amenities plans. Retained printed 2 BR B total despite a 0.01 sq ft component difference. The archived Belgrove and current Belmore materials show overlapping designs. The developer redirect alone does not resolve the legal identity; both protected URLs remain intact and this page uses original Belgrove-labelled evidence.

unavailable: Current project naming or legal relationship to Belmore, exact visitor entrance, operating Metro access and contracted unit-specific plans.
